items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Yes, and Trigger Alpert (phonetic spelling) had been with Bill Miller's band. Al Klink, Sid Cooper were Miller and Dorsey from Bill's band, and Nick and Joe Ferrante and Bobby Nichols from Dorsey.

ctx.x: I hate bells, no bells; I hate piccolos and as it turned out, a lot of people did, but when they released them they went and a year later they pushed us out on the road.
How did you put the band together, as far as the people you had from the studio days? Were they people that you knew?
Oh, yeah. Some of them we didn't, but most of them we did and most of those we didn't we got through recommendation, as with Rosie and Buster; we knew Don.
